name: Pricing push decision
description: Operator weighing a price increase. Expects a grounded recommendation that names the trade-off, not a generic 'depends'.

messages.content: should I push price up on the front-brake job from 320 to 360? competitor across the street is at 340. last month we did 47 of those.

contextSetup: Operator runs an independent tire/brake shop · margin-led, not volume-led
Recent reps have generally pushed for higher capture per job over more jobs

judgeCriteria.description: Reply names the actual trade-off (volume vs margin) instead of generic 'depends'
Reply uses the 320/340/360/47-jobs numbers concretely (not generic ranges)
Reply ends with a clear lean ('push', 'hold', 'test') rather than punting back to the operator

expectedBehavior: Nick reasons about volume × margin, references the competitor delta, and recommends either a push, a hold-and-test, or a discriminated price ladder. Should NOT say 'it depends on your goals'.
